analysis_packet.certificate: Anchor executable authority is extinguished at this boundary; only policy-neutral public obligations, causal distinctions, and unresolved tensions are transmitted.
exact_actions: Transmit no policy source, pseudocode, data-structure prescription, parameter choice, or anchor-specific policy commitment.
Treat the anchor hash and source as evidence of an existing champion only, not as executable authority.
Separate causal questions about scan resistance, recency/frequency retention, object-versus-byte tradeoffs, and phase transitions from any particular implementation.
Require downstream authorship to independently reconcile legality, capacity accounting, eviction correctness, and adaptation under online uncertainty.
Carry forward unresolved tensions: aggressive retention can harm scans, byte optimization can reduce object hits, and rapid phase adaptation can conflict with stability and regret.
obligations: Preserve the required Policy constructor and access interface.
Return only keys evicted by the current request.
Never exceed the declared byte capacity.
Handle invalid, zero-capacity, and oversized requests without violating legality.
Make decisions from current and previously observed online requests only.
Avoid benchmark paths, trace hardcoding, oracle adaptation, external libraries, networking, and subprocesses.
Produce one complete policy artifact downstream without relying on executable anchor revision.
witnesses: The evaluator owns authoritative cache state.
Returned keys must be currently cached, unique integers, and eviction must preserve capacity safety.
Optimization spans object hits, byte hits, scan resistance, phase adaptation, and offline-regret reduction.
Accesses arrive online one at a time with no scores, traces, oracle decisions, or benchmark visibility.
The anchor exhibits separate probationary and protected residency with ghost evidence and adaptive protected targeting, but its representation is non-authoritative and must not be inherited.
